{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., sentiment < 0.33) or recent low prices.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp price spikes (e.g., >10% above recent high) by applying a 10-20% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when sentiment > 0.33 — especially if recent prices are trending upward.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, reduce forecast volatility by 15-25% if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., >3 consecutive days), shift forecast downward by 2-5% per day.",
    "When sentiment history shows a recent upward trend, increase forecast lag by 1-2 days to avoid overreaction."
  ]
}
